title: Chemistry
description: ISC Class XI Chemistry: one theory paper of 3 hours carrying 70 marks plus 10 marks practical-file weightage and 20 marks practical examination.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Chemistry (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Physical Chemistry: mole concept, structure of atom, periodic table, chemical bonding, states of matter, thermodynamics; Inorganic Chemistry: hydrogen, s-block, p-block (Group 13 & 14), transition elements; Organic Chemistry: fundamentals, hydrocarbons, alcohols/phenols/ethers, aldehydes/ketones/carboxylic acids.

chapters.title: Mole Concept and Stoichiometry
chapters.blurb: Gay-Lussac, Avogadro, molar volume, empirical and molecular formula, limiting reagent.

chapters.title: Structure of Atom
chapters.blurb: Bohr's model, quantum numbers, shapes of orbitals, electronic configuration.

chapters.title: Periodic Table and Periodicity
chapters.blurb: Modern periodic law, periodic trends, ionisation energy, electron affinity, atomic radii.

chapters.title: Chemical Bonding
chapters.blurb: Ionic, covalent, coordinate, metallic bonding; VSEPR shapes; hydrogen bonding; hybridisation.

chapters.title: States of Matter
chapters.blurb: Kinetic theory, gas laws, van der Waals equation, liquid and solid states.

chapters.title: Chemical Thermodynamics
chapters.blurb: First law, enthalpy, Hess's law, entropy, Gibbs free energy, spontaneity.

chapters.title: Chemical Equilibrium
chapters.blurb: Equilibrium constant, Le Chatelier's principle, ionic and acid-base equilibria, pH, solubility product.

chapters.title: Hydrogen
chapters.blurb: Position in the periodic table, isotopes, preparation, properties, water and hydrogen peroxide.

chapters.title: s-Block Elements
chapters.blurb: General trends, alkali and alkaline earth metals, oxides, hydroxides, salts, diagonal relationship.

chapters.title: p-Block Elements: Group 13 & 14
chapters.blurb: Boron and aluminium chemistry, carbon, silicon, semiconductors.

chapters.title: Transition Elements
chapters.blurb: General characteristics, variable oxidation states, colour, magnetic properties, complexes, alloys.

chapters.title: Organic Chemistry: Fundamental Concepts
chapters.blurb: Electronic effects, nomenclature, isomerism, reaction mechanisms (SN1, SN2, electrophilic addition/substitution).

chapters.title: Hydrocarbons
chapters.blurb: Alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, arenes; preparation, properties and reactions of each class.

chapters.title: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
chapters.blurb: Nucleophilic addition, oxidation and reduction reactions, preparation and properties.
